blocks.caption: Wings of Yin and Yang: 9 out of 10 in everything

blocks.text: No pair is good at everything. Each has a temper: a great gift paid for with a weakness. Seven stats, each scored from 0 to 100, describe it.
The Wings menu shows five of them as bars of ten squares, one square for ten points. Glide and Lift work in silence.
Endurance
Your stamina: 50 at score 0, 300 at score 100.
Acceleration

Speed gained per second of beating: 2 m/s at 0, 10 m/s at 100. It also powers the brake and the height of the wing jump. One beat gives Acceleration divided by the beats per second, so slow, heavy strokes hit harder.
Speed
The top cruise speed you can reach by beating: 12 m/s at 0, 64 m/s at 100. Only a dive goes faster.
Handling
How fast your aim point turns: 40 degrees per second at 0, 150 at 100.
Stability
The calm of your hover, from 0 to 10. At 10 you hover as still as in creative mode.
Glide (hidden)
How well the air carries you: how far you glide and how little speed you lose between beats.
Lift (hidden)
The speed below which your wings stall: 14 m/s at 0, 3 m/s at 100.
Equipped stats and the collection
Each pair has two sets of numbers. Its own stats apply only while you wear it. Its collection bonus applies from the moment you own it, whatever pair you wear.

Your real score in a stat is the equipped score plus the bonuses of every pair you own, capped at 100. Each pair gives mostly in its strong points, so the Wings of Stone build your Endurance and Stability, the Wings of the Storm your Speed.
Own every pair but the two mythics, and every pair you wear flies at 10 out of 10 in everything. The mythics give no bonus, but fly beyond the cap: +20 in Speed.
